author: Mark Atwood
text:
Closed by commit 8065c58.

Added crate-jmap-calendars-server/tests/max_objects_in_set.rs mirroring the canonical
mail-server/tasks-server pattern (5 tests covering all 4 /set handlers + 1 at-limit
positive control).

The new test surfaced that 3 of 4 calendars-server /set handlers were missing the
cap-enforcement call that the canonical pattern mandates: handle_calendar_event_set,
handle_calendar_event_notification_set, handle_participant_identity_set. Only
handle_calendar_set had the enforce_max_objects_in_set call. Added the missing
call to each, citing bd:JMAP-ops7.31 inline.

This is exactly the asymmetric coverage gap the bead anticipated ('this is exactly
the kind of asymmetric coverage gap the canonical-template rule is supposed to
prevent'). The missing test was masking real bugs in 3 production code paths.
